bitcoin.read: 5 of 22 scored indicators lean bull, 3 bear, 14 neutral: a split, as close to a coin flip as the rules get. Bull: exchange flows, the cycle clock, the regression position, the 50-week average, the 50/200 cross. Bear: the drawdown, stablecoin supply, section 6 positioning. Resets still missing: Puell multiple, MVRV, weekly RSI, monthly RSI, the Mayer multiple, the one-year return, Pi Cycle. One reset is already in: price tagged the 200-week average at 0.95 on 28 Jun 2026, 3 weeks at or under the line. Clock: 926 days since the halving, 39% below the high of 6 Oct.

rows.bear: over 2.0 (the 2021 and 2025 tops; earlier tops were higher)
rows.bull: under 0.5 (issuance value at a cycle low)
rows.name: Puell multiple
rows.read: Between the reset band and the top zone; the 2022 low read 0.43.

rows.bear: at or over 2.5 (the 2021 tops; 2025 peaked at 2.3)
rows.bull: at or under 1.0 (price below the average cost basis)
rows.name: MVRV (market cap to realized cap)
rows.read: Above cost basis, below the top zone; the lows read 0.56 to 1.00.

rows.bull: at or under 7 (the 2018 to 2022 lows)
rows.name: ThermoCap multiple
rows.read: Between the lows' band (5 to 7) and the tops' band (29 and up).

rows.bear: percentile 80 or over (coins moving to exchanges)
rows.bull: three-year percentile 20 or under (coins leaving exchanges)
rows.name: Exchange net flow, 30 days, share of supply
rows.read: Coins are leaving exchanges at a pace in the bottom fifth of three years: accumulation.

rows.bull: 35 or under (every cycle low read 28 to 33)
rows.name: Weekly RSI (14)
rows.read: Weekly momentum is between the wash-out (35) and the top zone (70).

rows.bull: 45 or under (2015, 2018 and 2022 lows)
rows.name: Monthly RSI (14)
rows.read: Monthly momentum is between the lows' level (45) and the top zone (75).

rows.bull: 777 or more days (inside or past the prior lows' window)
rows.feed: calendar rule from the halving dates
rows.name: Cycle clock (days since the halving)
rows.read: Past the window the prior lows fell in (6 Jun to 31 Oct 2026); a low later than every prior cycle.

rows.bull: 70% or more (the shallowest cycle low was 71%)
rows.name: Drawdown from the all-time high
rows.read: The drawdown is shallower than any prior cycle low (85%, 84%, 77%); a low here would be a first.

rows.bull: minus 50% or worse (every cycle low was under minus 70%)
rows.name: One-year return
rows.read: The one-year return is between the lows' reset (under minus 50%) and the top zone (plus 100%).

rows.bear: at or over 1.5 (the April 2021 top; the last two tops read 1.47 and 1.18, so this line would have missed them)
rows.bull: at or under 0.8 (every cycle low read 0.40 to 0.71)
rows.name: Mayer multiple (price to the 200-day average)
rows.read: Between the lows' band (every cycle low read under 0.72) and the top zone (1.5); the last two tops read 1.47 and 1.18.

rows.bear: at or over 2.3 (the 2025 top; earlier tops reached 3.7 to 15.4)
rows.bull: at or under 1.00 (the cycle floor: every cycle has touched or broken it)
rows.name: Price against the 200-week average
rows.read: Above the 200-week floor, below the top zone; at the prior lows this read 0.68 to 1.48. The floor was tagged this cycle: 0.95 on 28 Jun 2026, 3 weeks at or under the line.

rows.read: Price sits in the bottom fifth of its distance from the long-run fit: where prior lows sat. Our own fit, a cycle position, not a target.
